0.3.3.name: add_class
0.3.3.description: Creates a class entry within CoshUI's class registers that lets users reuse style objects.

parameters.name: A `str` object that acts as the name of the class. This will be what you pass onto the `classes` field on Nodes or as a custom CoshML tag.
parameters.style: Either a `CoshStyling` or a `TextStyle` object, behavior will depend on what you pass in. If a CoshStyling object is passed in, it will let you reuse those styles for Nodes. If a TextStyle object is passed in, it will let you reuse those styles in CoshML as a tag.
